name: PCTG 3D-Fuel Pro @BBL A1M
filament_notes: 3D-Fuel Pro PCTG 1.75 mm (Amazon ASIN B0CGK4C8F5, order 112-3821238-6497025). Sources 21 Nov 2026: 3D-Fuel support 'Baseline Pro PCTG Settings for Printers Without a Profile' and 'Pro PCTG Print Profiles' (via search, pages themselves 403): nozzle 250-280 (mid 265), bed 80 on textured PEI, fan 5% min and 30-40% max (35 used), no feature over 150 mm/s, outer wall and top surface 100 mm/s or less, max volumetric 10-15 mm3/s (12 used), calibrate Flow Dynamics K per spool. Product page: dry 60-70 C 4-8 h. Avoid bare smooth PEI (use glue stick).
